sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase year tables and listings, ▶ Pages: a row that is read can be read again. Move the pointer over the row and click the ⟳ in its On stage cell: its event page and venue page are asked for whatever is kept, its year's listing too (on a listing, the year page), and the row's findings are made again. Up to three requests.

"Read every row again" in the ▶ Pages progress card does it for the whole table: every row goes back to "not read" and is read again when it is in view, never all at once; a venue and a year's listing are read again once. Rows not scrolled to before the page is left keep their stored copy.
